issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'פַּשְׁחוּר בֶּן מַלְכִּיָּה' (Pashhur son of Malkijah) and 'צְפַנְיָה בֶן מַעֲשֵׂיָה' (Zephaniah son of Maaseiah). The Chinese reverses the father-son relationships: it says '巴實錄兒子瑪基雅' (Pashhur's son Malkijah) and '祭司西番雅兒子瑪西雅' (priest Zephaniah's son Maaseiah), swapping the names so that the sons become fathers and vice versa.
